'''Boten''' is a Nogoyevian coastal and industrial city south of [[Migov]]. During the [[Nogoyevian War of Independence]], it became the site of the [[Siege of Boten]], one of the war's major urban engagements.

The source identifies Boten as a major port city with industrial capacity and strategic value for supply lines along the Vegar Ocean.
